provenance.tool: hand computation; tests/reference/derive_rates.py (Python 3.13 standard library: fractions, decimal)
provenance.steps: Worked check of the model contracts: balance(t-1) 100,000, scheduled principal 1,000 and prepaid principal 2,000 give A = 99,000 and SMM = 2,000 / 99,000 = 2/99 by hand. CPR = 1 - (97/99)^12 and CPR / 12 computed exactly in rationals and rounded to 40 significant digits. The values rounded to 8 places are those printed in MODEL_CONTRACTS.md.
